digest.component_or_area: git workflow tooling / commit message handling
propositions: git commit --amend -F or -m replaces the entire commit message and drops the Change-Id trailer, causing Gerrit to stamp a new Change-Id and create a duplicate change instead of a patchset on the existing change
git hooks cannot distinguish between an amend with -F and a fresh commit with -F, so hook-based detection is not feasible
a make amend-msg wrapper should amend HEAD with file contents while preserving the existing Change-Id trailer from HEAD
make amend-msg must fail loudly and non-zero when HEAD carries no Change-Id rather than silently producing a commit that will be stamped with a fresh one
AGENTS.md documentation must be updated to name make amend-msg as the path for rewritten commit messages and warn that --amend -m or -F drop the Change-Id and create duplicate Gerrit changes
